settings.label: Stargate API address
settings.help: HTTPS address of the fleet's Stargate API on a private network (Tailscale, Cloudflare Access), or http://localhost:<port> through an SSH tunnel.

settings.label: API token
settings.help: Run stargate api token on the fleet VM and paste the result.

settings.label: Motion
settings.help: Reduced replaces the warp with a short crossfade and stops orbits and the radar sweep.

settings.label: Frame-time readout
settings.help: Shows frame times, frame rate and the quality level over the map. Shift+P shows or hides it while the map has focus.
